sentences.en: Some Southwestern Native Americans lived in adobe houses called pueblos.
sentences.zh: 一些西南部的原住民住在被称为普韦布洛的土坯房子里。

sentences.en: Adobe and Apple both have top-notch video editing programs.
sentences.zh: Adobe和苹果都有顶尖的视频编辑软件。

sentences.en: At last! Adobe dumps this shitty Flash for mobiles.
sentences.zh: 终于！Adobe把这该死的Flash移出移动设备了。
